subject: GEN3 PHASE 1 READY: exact CAS cover-prewarm implementation packaged
body: Primary completed the Gen3 Phase 1 authority implementation against baseline 45bb0d326899c0e08415928224cfea0ff58d2d4e. V3 remains compatibility-only; Gen3 coordinator uses new COVER_PANEL_LEASE_V4 PREWARM with expected-current shellSession/leaseId/leaseEpoch/owner identity plus new owner serviceEpoch/closeCycleId/transitionGeneration. Fresh IDLE acquisition is tokenless by definition; all non-IDLE adoption is exact CAS; stale requests are inert; same-owner retries are idempotent; crossed first-acquisition can reconcile and retry up to 2 times. No raw physical OFF or task migration added. Local validation: abstract authority model 9/9 PASS; production Fold7CoverPanelLease payload kotlinc compile PASS; production-payload race harness 5/5 PASS. Full Android Gradle compile/test remains CI-gated because this phase is packaged for repository application, not yet committed to main. This is NOT the next physical field-test build.
